---
Title: "Mallard Duck Map"
Author: "Andrew Lucas"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

mallards_sf <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds") |>
  filter(lat >= 46, lat <= 55, long >= 7, long <= 25) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = "lightgray", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = mallards_sf, aes(color = duck_id), size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(7, 25), ylim = c(46, 55), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard GPS fixes",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck"
  )
```
